channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Additional case of measles exposure reported at Disneyland, health officials say
item.description: The potential exposure happened on Jan. 22.

item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in desperate video plea to potential kidnappers of her mother
item.description: "We received your message, and we understand. We beg you now to return our mother to us so that we can celebrate with her," the NBC "Today" host said in a video posted on social media.

item.title: Patriots-Seahawks Super Bowl is not so much of a rematch as it is a matchup of contrasts
item.description: An All-Pro wide receiver vs. one of the NFL’s best young cornerbacks. The matchup between New England and Seattle is all about contrasts.

item.title: Bob Baffert’s Plutarch wins at Santa Anita, jumps into Kentucky Derby picture
item.description: The improving colt and jockey Florent Geroux score a mild upset in the Robert B. Lewis Stakes as Intrepido runs second, Desert Gate fourth.

item.title: General manager Rob Pelinka addresses future of Lakers, Luke Kennard trade
item.description: Pelinka tells reporters that the Lakers were "aggressive" at the trade deadline, but in how they declined potentially detrimental short-term and long-term options rather than making numerous trades.

item.title: Clippers sign Kobe Sanders to standard contract
item.description: Sanders, who is averaging 7 points, 2.5 rebounds and 1.7 assists in 21.5 minutes per game this season, moves from a two-way deal to the 15-man roster.

item.title: Luka-less Lakers hold off short-handed Warriors for 3rd straight win
item.description: LeBron James has 20 points and 10 assists as the Lakers beat the Warriors without Stephen Curry, 105-99, despite missing Luka Doncic and late scratch DeAndre Ayton because of a knee injury.

item.title: USC men hit with injury again ahead of road trip to Penn State, Ohio State
item.description: Leading scorer Chad Baker-Mazara is day-to-day with a knee injury, leaving the Trojans without a key starter.

item.title: UCLA men’s basketball edges Washington
item.description: Trent Perry scores 23 points and Donovan Dent adds 17 points and 10 assists as the Bruins beat the Huskies 77-73. Tyler Bilodeau and Eric Dailey Jr. help UCLA build a late cushion after Washington closes within two with under six minutes left.

item.title: Lakers sign Kobe Bufkin to 2-year deal, sources say
item.description: Bufkin is averaging nearly 25 points per game in the G-League and will have sign a team option for the 2026-2027 season.
